note.p: Reginald Fowden Lt 38th foot 28.9.1797 Capt 14.8.180, Reginald son of Reginald Fowden and Amelia Witherall born 23.11.1801 bapt 16.12.1801 St Anne Soho, Capt Reginald Fowden from half pay of 35th foot to 3rd foot 11.2.1804, served till 1808, Reginald Fowden Esq of Cheadle subscr to novel by Henrietta Rouviere 1801, will PCC 1819 Reginald Fowden of Bath (seen) William Fowden ensign 3rd foot 10.10.1805, Elizabeth Ann dau of Wm and Anne Fowden bapt 14.8.1808 St James Piccy, will PCC 1849 William Fowden half pay Captain of Dragoons, Denbighshire Thomas Fowden's new invention of metallic paste (for army bread!) discussed in Committee of House of Commons 8.5.1800 The name Fowden found mostly in Lancs and N Wales
